sections.title: Agents (overview)
items: “Start new agent”: pick a folder; the agent starts and gets going at once with its start request (e.g. the AI-Connect watcher). Resuming starts without it.
Sorting cards: drag at a free spot with the mouse; with a finger, hold briefly first. The order is the same on every device.
Context ring: green below 50 %, amber above, red from 70 % – time for /compact or a new conversation soon.
Effort slider and ultracode apply per project folder. While the agent is working you choose: after the answer, or now (restart with resume).
Quota at the top: Claude's used five-hour and weekly limits, once a session has reported them.

“Start” on the card: the permission mode the agent starts in – Ask, Edit (file edits without asking), Auto or Plan. Auto by default; applies from the next start, inside the agent Shift+Tab switches it.
When an agent asks for permission, its card shows the command with “Allow” and “Deny”. The terminal asks the same; the first answer counts.

sections.title: Workspaces
items: Every browser tab has its own workspace; a reload keeps it.
Type a name at the top and press Enter: the workspace is saved and shows up in the overview and in the bar of every workspace.
Clicking another workspace jumps to the tab that already shows it (↗︎), otherwise this tab switches. A middle click opens a new tab.
Jumping only finds tabs opened from within Agent-Orc – so open further workspaces through the buttons; they can then be detached onto other monitors.
On the phone (installed app) the bar switches within the same window.
“+” adds a running agent as a column, “− n +” sets how many columns fill the screen.
Dragging a column head sorts the columns; dragging the divider on its right edge changes the width, a double click resets it.

sections.title: Terminal
items: Input field at the bottom: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
Microphone: dictation through Whisper; the GPU is done at once, the CPU is slower but always there. If it fails, “Retry” sends the same recording again.

Paperclip: take a photo, pick a picture or screenshot from the gallery, capture the screen (desktop) or attach a file – it lands in the project folder and it shows as a small preview above the input field (× removes it) and goes to the agent with the next message. A screenshot from the clipboard can also simply be pasted into the input field (Ctrl+V).
Grip on the right (jog): pull up or down to scroll, the further the faster. Mouse wheel and swiping scroll as well.
A− / A+ changes the font size of this terminal only; the text view shows the screen for selecting and copying.
The key bar sends Esc, Tab, arrows, Ctrl and so on – Ctrl and Alt apply to the next key.

sections.title: Settings (gear)
items: Font, font size, line spacing and lines per scroll step – stored on this device.

Notifications: switch them on per device in the gear menu. You then get a message when an agent is done or waits for a permission or an answer; tapping it opens the agent. Only over HTTPS; on iPhones only in the installed app.
